zones.title: Twilio voice entry
zones.body: Twilio posts the inbound call. The config rows and the first GB fixture customer shape the synthetic UUI; with an OpenAI project the TwiML dials the SIP ingress (referUrl AR-53, action AR-54), without it the caller hears the lab line.

zones.title: Respond and log
zones.body: TwiML as text/xml, then the call is logged with the UUI it was given.

zones.title: Config admin
zones.body: POST ar/proof/config {rows: [{key, value}]} with the gateway bearer: upsert on key. Values come from the seed script, never from a node field.

panels.title: AR-50 Twilio voice entry
panels.body: Proof of decision doc 13: Twilio stands in for the contact center trunk. No Twilio signature check on the lab (PoC exception, test plan). The UUI is the first GB fixture customer, hex-encoded as contact center would send it.
